course.title: Unit 2 No Rules, No Order【例句】
course.description: Section A What rules do we follow?

sentences.content: What school rules does the photo show?
sentences.english: What school rules does the photo show ?
sentences.chinese: 这张照片展示了哪些校规？

sentences.content: Do you follow rules like these?
sentences.english: Do you follow rules like these ?
sentences.chinese: 你会遵守类似这样的规则吗？

sentences.content: Don’t run in the hallway, please.
sentences.english: Don't run in the hallway , please
sentences.chinese: 请不要在走廊里奔跑。

sentences.content: You can only wear the uniform at school.
sentences.english: You can only wear the uniform at school
sentences.chinese: 你只能在学校穿制服。

sentences.content: You can’t wear that jacket here.
sentences.english: You can't wear that jacket here
sentences.chinese: 你不能在这里穿那件夹克。

sentences.content: You know you mustn’t litter.
sentences.english: You know you mustn't litter
sentences.chinese: 你知道不能乱扔垃圾。

sentences.content: We have to keep the school clean and tidy.
sentences.english: We have to keep the school clean and tidy
sentences.chinese: 我们必须保持学校干净整洁。

sentences.content: Walk in the hallway. Don’t run!
sentences.english: Walk in the hallway . Don't run !
sentences.chinese: 在走廊上行走，不要奔跑！

sentences.content: You have to wear the uniform.
sentences.english: You have to wear the uniform
sentences.chinese: 你必须穿制服。

sentences.content: You mustn’t wear other clothes to school instead.
sentences.english: You mustn't wear other clothes to school instead
sentences.chinese: 你绝不能穿其他衣服代替校服去学校。

sentences.content: Don’t litter. Make sure to keep the school tidy.
sentences.english: Don't litter . Make sure to keep the school tidy
sentences.chinese: 请勿乱扔垃圾。务必保持校园整洁。

sentences.content: We must be polite and treat everyone with respect.
sentences.english: We must be polite and treat everyone with respect
sentences.chinese: 我们必须礼貌待人，尊重每一个人。

sentences.content: It’s my first day here.
sentences.english: It's my first day here
sentences.chinese: 这是我在这里的第一天。

sentences.content: Is everything OK?
sentences.english: Is everything OK ?
sentences.chinese: 一切都还好吗？

sentences.content: I can lend you my pen.
sentences.english: I can lend you my pen
sentences.chinese: 我可以把笔借给你。

sentences.content: Would you like a sweet?
sentences.english: Would you like a sweet ?
sentences.chinese: 你想要一颗糖吗？

sentences.content: No, thank you. We can’t eat snacks in class.
sentences.english: No , thank you . We can't eat snacks in class
sentences.chinese: 不用了，谢谢。我们不能在课堂上吃零食。

sentences.content: Can we drink water?
sentences.english: Can we drink water ?
sentences.chinese: 我们可以喝水吗？

sentences.content: Yes, of course.
sentences.english: Yes , of course
sentences.chinese: 是的，当然。

sentences.content: Oh, but we mustn’t bring our mobile phones to class.
sentences.english: Oh , but we mustn't bring our mobile phones to class
sentences.chinese: 哦，但我们可不能带手机去上课。

sentences.content: We have to turn them off and keep them in our lockers.
sentences.english: We have to turn them off and keep them in our lockers
sentences.chinese: 我们必须关掉它们，并把它们锁在储物柜里。

sentences.content: That’s another rule.
sentences.english: That's another rule
sentences.chinese: 这是另一条规则。

sentences.content: Thanks for telling me.
sentences.english: Thanks for telling me
sentences.chinese: 谢谢你告诉我。

sentences.content: You’re welcome.
sentences.english: You're welcome
sentences.chinese: 不客气。
